title: 32 ounce food containers
text: 32 ounce food containers. This purchase was very sad for me, the container's defiantly are of very good quality, sturdy, sealed well, but unfortunately could not be used, first instead of receiving 24 there were only 22 container's but 24 lid's. The plastic bag with the content label on was torn and badly damaged. So Amazon decided to take clear shipping and packaging tape and wrap around numerous times attaching stacks of lids directly on the container's so tightly with tape causing the containers to become miss shaped and tape residue stuck to everything, I have never seen such poorly disrespect to a product purchased by a customer, in shipping the packaged was crushed, but that was the least of the problems compared to the way Amazon packaged it, this was defiantly not the fault of the product, the product was excellent.
